threads.body: This equality branch now permits local installs when the floor is finalized (`1.2b0`) as well as when it has a `.dev` suffix, but the fallback diagnostic at line 239 still says local/editable installs are allowed only for `.dev` floors. When the check rejects another local entry during a finalized cycle, that message contradicts the rule; update it to describe current-cycle floors instead.
